{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify rows with invalid revenue
invalid_rows = df[df['revenue'].isna()]

# Display the invalid rows
type(invalid_rows), invalid_rows.head()"}
